title: Software Engineer (Frontend Platform), Native Git
description:
**Who Are We?**
Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.
  
  
The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.
  
  
P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Local Mode team is building Native Git Postman—the bet that an API platform should live where developers already are: in the repository, on the filesystem, right next to the code. Instead of building a separate integration for every Git host, we’ve built a Git integration directly around the filesystem. Collections, specifications, environments, flows, and mocks become plain files that move through branches, pull requests, and CI like any other source code.
  
  
This foundation also makes agents genuinely useful in Postman. With filesystem, shell, and Git access, an agent can reproduce a failure, patch the code, verify the fix, and prepare the change for review.
  
  
If you’ve shipped developer tooling or desktop-class infrastructure, enjoy owning ambiguous problems end to end, and have opinions about what developer workflows should look like in the agentic era, you’ll fit in quickly.
  
  
**The Role**
We’re looking for a Software Engineer who is energized by complex product and engineering challenges without obvious answers. You’ll help make Postman truly Git native by building workflows that feel natural to developers while remaining secure, reliable, and performant at scale.
  
  
You’ll work at the intersection of product engineering, Git, local filesystems, desktop infrastructure, command-line tooling, synchronization, cloud services, and data systems. You’ll own problems from discovery and design through implementation, rollout, and iteration.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own secure, performant, and scalable Git-native developer workflows across visual and command-line experiences.
* Build product features using JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Electron, APIs, and databases.
* Design reliable synchronization that handles conflicts, concurrency, retries, interrupted operations, and partial failures without compromising user data.
* Solve cross-platform problems involving Git, filesystems, permissions, processes, workers, and file watching across macOS, Windows, Linux, and WSL.
* Improve performance for large repositories, deep file trees, data-intensive operations, application startup, and command-line execution.
* Strengthen reliability through automated testing, observability, diagnostics, secure defaults, and clear recovery paths.
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and design to prototype new developer and agentic workflows, make pragmatic trade-offs, and take successful ideas to production.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 2–4 years of software engineering experience, with a track record of building and shipping production features.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript, with hands-on experience using React and Node.js.
* Experience working with APIs and databases, including relational or NoSQL systems, data modeling, and secure handling of application data.
* A practical understanding of Git, filesystems, command-line tools, networking, operating systems, and cross-platform development.
* The ability to design asynchronous systems with sound approaches to concurrency, consistency, error handling, retries, cancellation, and recovery.
* A commitment to testable, maintainable, secure, and performant code, supported by strong computer science fundamentals.
* Strong ownership, product judgment, and communication skills, with the confidence to navigate ambiguity and challenge assumptions constructively.

**Why Join Us?**

* Build for millions. Help shape how developers around the world build, test, and collaborate on APIs.
* Define a new developer workflow. Help establish what a Git-native API platform should look and feel like.
* Solve meaningful engineering problems. Work on synchronization, reliability, data integrity, performance, and cross-platform behavior.
* Own problems end to end. Work in a culture that values curiosity, ownership, trust, and winning together.
* Grow with the team. Receive competitive compensation and benefits, a flexible schedule, and meaningful opportunities to expand your scope.

What Else?
  
  
In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.

For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.

title: SDE II, Amazon Business Operations
description:
**Description**
Are you excited about building software that operates at massive scale and directly impacts millions of customers? As a Software Development Engineer II for Amazon Business Operations, you will design, build, and deliver features that solve unique B2B supply chain tech problems while raising the bar on code quality and operational excellence. You will work across the full software development lifecycle, from defining requirements and designing systems to deploying and operating production services. This is an opportunity to grow your technical skills, mentor fellow engineers, and contribute to software that matters. If you are a collaborative, curious engineer who thrives on turning ambiguous problems into clean, maintainable solutions, we want to hear from you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and implement software solutions across major portions of your team's systems, balancing functional and non-functional requirements such as scalability, performance, and security.
* Deliver working features spanning the full software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, system design, coding, testing, deployment, and operational support.
* Actively participate in code reviews, providing meaningful and constructive feedback to teammates, and coach others on producing high-quality, maintainable code.
* Identify root causes of operational issues and drive permanent fixes, continuously improving system reliability and your team's operational processes.
* Collaborate with customers, stakeholders, and cross-functional partners to understand business needs and ensure your solutions deliver the right customer value.

A day in the life
  
  
You start your morning reviewing deployment metrics from a recent launch, then jump into a design discussion with teammates to map out a new feature. After lunch you write and test code, pausing to review a pull request from a colleague and share feedback. You wrap up by triaging an operational alert, identifying the root cause, and documenting a fix. Throughout it all, you balance new feature work with operational improvements and mentoring newer engineers on your team.
  
  
**About The Team**
AB Operations is the logistics partner for Amazon Business and owns the delivery experience for commercial customers. * Debug and resolve customer-facing identity/access issues, working with support to triage escalations quickly.
* Contribute to build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI) as needed.

* Communicate clearly with product and engineering stakeholders on design tradeoffs, security posture, and escalation status.

* Minimum experience of at least 8 Years

* Deep, practical knowledge of identity protocols: OIDC/OAuth 2.0 and SAML 2.0 — including token/assertion internals, standard flows, and failure modes.

* Applied cryptography/PKI experience: X.509, JWT/JWKS, key rotation, TLS.

* Solid understanding of OS fundamentals, networking, and concurrency.
* Working knowledge of Linux; comfortable writing shell/bash scripts.
* Simple, effective written and verbal communication.

* Directory internals (schema, bind operations).
* HTTP internals and reverse proxying (TLS, header injection).

title: Software Engineer (Frontend UI), Native Git
description:
**Who Are We?**
Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.
  
  
The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.
  
  
P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Local Mode team is building Native Git Postman—the bet that an API platform should live where developers already are: in the repository, on the filesystem, right next to the code. Instead of building a separate integration for every Git host, we’ve built a Git integration directly around the filesystem. Collections, specifications, environments, flows, and mocks become plain files that move through branches, pull requests, and CI like any other source code.
  
  
This foundation also makes agents genuinely useful in Postman. With filesystem, shell, and Git access, an agent can reproduce a failure, patch the code, verify the fix, and prepare the change for review.
  
  
If you’ve shipped developer tooling or desktop-class infrastructure, enjoy owning ambiguous problems end to end, and have opinions about what developer workflows should look like in the agentic era, you’ll fit in quickly.
  
  
**The Role**
We’re looking for a frontend-focused Software Engineer to help us define and build the best and most intuitive Git-native API client for developers.
  
  
You’ll shape how repositories, local files, branches, changes, conflicts, synchronization, and collaboration should look and feel inside Postman. This is a product-focused frontend role with meaningful systems depth: you’ll primarily build user experiences, while also contributing to Node.js, Electron, workers, synchronization logic, and command-line workflows when needed.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design and build intuitive Git-native workflows for browsing and editing local resources, reviewing changes, resolving conflicts, and sharing work.
* Translate complex filesystem, Git, and cloud state into polished React experiences that developers can easily understand and trust.
* Contribute beyond the interface through Node.js, Electron, workers, asynchronous APIs, and command-line developer workflows.
* Design clear behavior for long-running operations, including progress, cancellation, retries, partial success, diagnostics, and recovery.
* Deliver responsive, accessible, and keyboard-first experiences that perform well with large repositories and deep file trees.
* Build quality through component, integration, and end-to-end testing, supported by instrumentation and user feedback.
* Collaborate with product, design, and engineering to prototype new ideas and define what Git-native and agentic API development should become.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 2–4 years of software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping high-quality production experiences.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, HTML, and CSS.
* Strong Node.js knowledge and experience with Electron or similar desktop concepts, including processes, IPC, and workers.
* A practical understanding of Git, filesystems, command-line workflows, web fundamentals, and cross-platform development.
* Experience modeling complex asynchronous UI state while maintaining strong performance, accessibility, and predictable behavior.
* A commitment to testable and maintainable code, with experience in component, integration, or browser-level testing.
* Strong ownership, product judgment, and communication skills, with an ability to simplify technical concepts and navigate ambiguity.

**Why Join Us?**

* Build for millions. Help shape how developers around the world build, test, and collaborate on APIs.
* Define a new kind of developer tool. Help establish what the best Git-native API client should look and feel like.
* Solve meaningful product problems. Turn complex Git, filesystem, synchronization, and collaboration concepts into intuitive experiences.
* Own problems end to end. Work in a culture that values curiosity, ownership, trust, and winning together.
* Grow with the team. Receive competitive compensation and benefits, a flexible schedule, and meaningful opportunities to expand your scope.

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.

We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. title: Senior AI Business Automation Engineer - Technology IT
description:
**About Signant Health**

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.

**About The Role**

Signant Health is seeking a Senior AI Business Automation Engineer who works in two complementary modes. In one mode, you embed directly with functional Subject Matter Experts — sitting shoulder-to-shoulder with the people doing the work, understanding their workflows including the workarounds and group knowledge that never appear in process documents, and then designing, prototyping, and delivering the custom technical solutions that transform how those teams operate.

In the other mode, you work on a small, focused delivery squad — sometimes leading, sometimes contributing — tasked with shipping AI-driven automation into a business unit at pace. In both modes the discipline is the same: get close to the real work, find the highest-leverage process to reinvent, and put working code in front of real users quickly.

The role lives inside IT and carries the full weight of our infrastructure, data, integration, automation, and information security standards required of a clinical-trial technology provider. Your measure of success is the number of workflows you have permanently transformed and the extent to which the business teams you work with start every task with an AI tool.

**What You Will Do**

* Flex between two operating modes: embed directly with a cohort of business SMEs to surface the highest-leverage workflows to reinvent with an AI-first design; and contribute to or lead small, focused delivery squads tasked with shipping AI-driven automation into a business unit at pace.
* Design, prototype, and deliver working solutions — custom tools, AI agents, automations, and reusable skills — tailored to each engagement's specific workflows, using a cadence of regular incremental delivery against real workflow data.
* Coach and partner with the business users you work alongside, taking them through a progressive journey: from awareness, to first win, to regular AI integration, to full workflow transformation.
* Develop and deploy AI agents leveraging LLMs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, end-to-end automations across REST APIs, webhooks, and third-party SaaS, and secure data pipelines — built to enterprise standards.
* Build every solution for handoff from day one — technology choices, documentation, observability, and runbooks designed so other engineers can operate and evolve the solution without ongoing involvement from you.
* Recognise patterns across engagements and systematically scale what works — tools and transformation patterns made reusable for peers and documented for other engineers.
* Translate observed business problems into technical solutions and share wins visibly within your cohort and with leadership, with ROI, effort, and risk articulated to make prioritisation decisions easy.
* Participate in end-to-end testing and quality validation of AI, automation, and integrated solutions prior to production deployment.
* Use AI development tools fluently throughout the build lifecycle — AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot), eval harnesses, golden datasets, regression suites, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints — to validate accuracy, safety, and business alignment before production deployment.
* Ensure automation solutions meet enterprise standards for security, scalability, and maintainability, including SOC 2 and ISO 27001 compliance requirements for automation and data handling.
* Mentor both directions: upskill business users to build and maintain their own AI-assisted workflows, and support junior engineers by establishing reusable patterns, solution designs, and runbooks.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in enterprise automation, software development, or IT engineering.
* Hands-on experience designing and operating workflow automation (self-hosted or cloud) with REST API and webhook integrations across enterprise SaaS platforms.
* 2+ years of experience building with the modern AI development toolkit: LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or equivalent), MCP servers and clients, agent frameworks, AI coding assistants used as a daily driver, structured prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and eval harnesses for production.
* Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and Python; experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Demonstrated ability to discover real workflows by working closely with practitioners — surfacing the workarounds, shared spreadsheets, and undocumented group knowledge that determine whether an AI solution works on real edge cases.
* Comfortable operating in small, high-velocity delivery teams — able to step into either a lead or contributor role on a squad of 2–4 engineers and hold a clear delivery line under time pressure.
* Ability to communicate technical solutions clearly to both engineering teams and executive stakeholders, with demonstrated experience authoring business cases, solution designs, and implementation roadmaps.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Relevant professional certifications in IT service management, project management, or enterprise automation platforms (e.g. ITIL, PMP, or platform-specific certifications).

* Proven track record of leading technical projects independently from requirements through production deployment, including stakeholder management, without formal authority over other team members
* Excellent technical writing and documentation skills, capable of producing architecture diagrams, runbooks, and specifications usable by both technical and non-technical audiences

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
**Our Mission**
**SPAN is enabling electrification for all ⚡**
**We are a mission-driven company designing, building, and deploying products that electrify the built environment, reduce carbon emissions, and slow the effects of climate change.**

* Decarbonization is the process to reduce or remove greenhouse gas emissions, especially carbon dioxide, from entering our atmosphere.
* Electrification is the process of replacing fossil fuel appliances that run on gas or oil with all-electric upgrades for a cleaner way to power our lives.

**At SPAN, We Believe In**

* Enabling homes and vehicles powered by clean energy
* Making electrification upgrades possible
* Building more resilient homes with reliable backup
* Designing a flexible and distributed electrical grid

**The Role**
We are looking for a Salesforce Developer to build and own the automation, data model, and custom functionality behind SPAN's commercial operations. This is a hands-on build seat: you will design and ship record-triggered and screen Flows, model custom objects and relationships, write Apex and Lightning Web Components where a declarative approach won't scale, and deploy your work across sandboxes to production with change-management rigor. You will work directly with Sales, Operations, Finance, and Supply Chain stakeholders to turn business processes into scalable Salesforce solutions.
  
  
This role supports all channels of the SPAN commercial team, including our CPQ/quoting pipeline, Lead Pass routing, installer and builder portals, and the order-to-fulfillment integration.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and build Salesforce automation end to end, primarily in Flow (record-triggered before/after-save, screen flows, subflows, invocable actions), with bulk-safe, recursion-aware design.
* Model and maintain custom schema: custom objects, junction objects, master-detail and lookup relationships, record types, and validation rules.
* Write Apex (triggers, controllers, test classes) and build Lightning Web Components when declarative tools can't meet the requirement, with proper test coverage.
* Gather requirements from cross-functional stakeholders, author design specs and release documentation, and translate business process into documented, scalable solutions.
* Own deployments across multiple sandboxes to production using Gearset, following SPAN's change-management and release-documentation conventions.
* Maintain and extend the security model: permission sets, field-level security, profiles, and sharing.
* Support and enhance the core commercial surfaces: CPQ/quoting, Lead Pass, installer/builder Experience Cloud portals, and the Salesforce side of the order/fulfillment integration.
* Use AI to work with greater leverage, both to increase your own delivery velocity (e.g., AI coding assistants to ship Apex/LWC faster) and to build AI-enabled solutions (Agentforce, Einstein, prompt-driven automation) that streamline Sales and Sales Operations processes.

**About You**
**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years in a Salesforce Developer, Administrator, or Business Systems Analyst role, with a demonstrable record of hands-on building, not solely analysis, support, or documentation.
* Advanced Flow expertise: record-triggered flows (before-save and after-save), screen flows, subflows, and invocable actions, with an understanding of bulk safety, recursion control, and run context.
* Strong Salesforce data modeling: custom objects, junction objects, master-detail and lookup relationships, record types, and validation rules.
* Proficiency with SOQL, including relationship queries, and a working understanding of governor limits.
* Demonstrated ability to write Apex (triggers, controllers, test classes) and build Lightning Web Components for custom UI, with proper test coverage.
* Experience deploying across multiple sandbox environments to production with a formal change-management process (Gearset or an equivalent DevOps tool).
* Fluency with the Salesforce security model: permission sets, field-level security, profiles, and sharing rules.
* Experience gathering requirements from a diverse set of business stakeholders and translating them into technical designs and documentation.
* Experience in a fast-moving, growth-oriented B2B and/or channel sales environment.
* Salesforce Platform Developer I certification, or equivalent demonstrable development experience.
* Driven, detail-oriented, get-it-done mentality.

* Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.
* Experience with Experience Cloud / Communities administration (sites, sharing, security).
* Experience with Salesforce CPQ or another quoting/pricing system.
* Experience with Account Engagement (Pardot).
* Experience integrating Salesforce with middleware or ERP systems (Boomi, NetSuite), including external-ID patterns and platform-event-driven design.

title: Principal Engineer – Software Architecture and Modernization
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!
  
  
Our Values
  
  
**Best Life**
We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.
  
  
**Growth Mindset**
We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.
  
  
**One Team**
From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
Lead software architecture and modernization
  
  
Shape the evolution of legacy applications into well-structured, domain-oriented software. Define target architecture, module and service boundaries, migration seams, compatibility strategies, and incremental paths that teams can implement safely.
  
  
Stay deeply hands-on in code
  
  
Contribute directly to critical implementations, prototypes, refactoring, code reviews, and production fixes. Work comfortably in backend code and frameworks such as Java/Springboot, Golang, Node/TypeScript, or similar backend ecosystems, and help teams improve application structure, runtime behavior, and maintainability.
  
  
Design strong domain models and APIs
  
  
Create clear domain abstractions, ownership boundaries, service contracts, and APIs. Improve how business rules are represented in code and keep consumers insulated from legacy storage and implementation details.
  
  
Modernize application foundations
  
  
Guide framework and runtime upgrades, dependency modernization, concurrency and lifecycle improvements, and the decomposition of tightly coupled code. Use practical refactoring strategies that keep large systems releasable throughout the work.
  
  
Engineer for correctness, performance, and reliability
  
  
Diagnose difficult behavior through code, runtime evidence, database interactions, and dependency flows. Fix root causes in implementation and design, including concurrency defects, inefficient data access, resource contention, failure propagation, and recovery behavior.
  
  
Improve data access and integration design
  
  
Move business logic out of database-centric implementations and into testable application code. Design effective persistence, transaction, caching, messaging, and event-consumer patterns while preserving historical, reporting, and audit needs.
  
  
Raise the bar for code quality and testing
  
  
Establish strong practices for unit, integration, contract, and functional testing. Improve code review, static analysis, dependency management, feature controls, and validation so teams can change complex software with confidence.
  
  
Create reusable engineering patterns
  
  
Turn successful designs into clear patterns, reference implementations, libraries, and architecture decisions that help teams solve recurring software problems consistently.
  
  
Turn technical strategy into cross-team execution
  
  
Translate architectural risk into clear code-level priorities, decisions, ownership, and sequenced implementation plans. Partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to move complex software initiatives from design through working code.
  
  
What This Is Not
  
  
This is not a people-management or architecture-only role. The engineer is expected to contribute directly to implementation and production outcomes.
  
  
This is not limited to greenfield design or modernization for its own sake. Decisions must balance long-term software quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications.
  
  
What You Bring
  
  
Deep backend and distributed-systems engineering
  
  
You have substantial experience designing, building, operating, and evolving production backend systems, services, APIs, and distributed applications.
  
  
Credible hands-on implementation depth
  
  
You can move from architecture into code, configuration, instrumentation, and diagnosis. Exact experience with Java/Springboot or Golang or Node/Typescript is relevant, but the key here is moving ideas into shippable software solutions and not on the technology.
  
  
Service transformation and architecture judgment
  
  
You can define service boundaries, domain ownership, migration strategies, integration patterns, and practical architecture decisions for complex existing environments.
  
  
Production reliability and performance expertise
  
  
You can trace difficult behavior through application code, runtime state, database interactions, and dependency flows, then implement fixes that improve correctness, concurrency, performance, and recovery behavior.
  
  
Software design and refactoring depth
  
  
You can improve large codebases through domain modeling, modular design, dependency management, incremental refactoring, and carefully chosen abstractions. You know how to create better seams without forcing risky rewrites.
  
  
Data and integration depth
  
  
You understand relational databases, SQL behavior, messaging, event consumers, data movement, caching, and the tradeoffs involved in separating applications from legacy data dependencies.
  
  
Strong testing and code-quality discipline
  
  
You treat automated testing, code review, static analysis, dependency health, secure coding, and production validation as essential parts of software design—not downstream concerns.
  
  
Principal-level technical leadership
  
  
You create clarity across teams, challenge weak assumptions constructively, communicate risk in business terms, and help groups converge on decisions they can execute.
  
  
An opportunity-focused approach to AI-assisted engineering
  
  
You actively look for ways AI can expand engineering leverage across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, refactoring, test generation, debugging, documentation, and planning. You help turn promising uses into repeatable practices that make strong engineers more effective.
  
  
Bonus Points
  
  
Experience modernizing large complex software systems, including runtime and framework upgrades.
  
  
Experience decomposing monoliths, extracting services, or establishing modular boundaries within large existing applications.
  
  
Experience with Oracle or other enterprise relational databases, Kafka or similar messaging systems, and complex data migration or reporting dependencies.
  
  
Experience with profiling, runtime instrumentation, concurrency analysis, database-performance diagnosis, or tuning.
  
  
Experience applying AI coding agents for codebase analysis, implementation, testing, and software modernization.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
Modernization advances without destabilizing the business
  
  
Critical migrations have clear boundaries, sequencing, ownership, and safety controls. Teams retire legacy constraints while maintaining compatibility and operational continuity.
  
  
Critical software becomes easier to change
  
  
Codebases have clearer boundaries, stronger tests, healthier dependencies, and fewer hidden couplings. Teams can add capabilities and modernize incrementally without destabilizing unrelated behavior.
  
  
Architecture decisions become executable
  
  
Teams understand the target state, the next practical step, and the tradeoffs behind key decisions. Cross-team dependencies and risks are surfaced early and actively managed.
  
  
Engineering quality improves across the lifecycle
  
  
Test coverage, code review, static analysis, dependency health, and production validation become stronger and more consistent across the software in scope.
  
  
AI expands engineering leverage
  
  
AI becomes an effective part of how teams understand code, explore designs, implement changes, generate tests, diagnose problems, and document systems.
  
  
Why This Matters
  
  
ABC Fitness depends on critical software and data flows that must evolve without compromising the businesses and members they support. Strong architecture is valuable only when it produces clearer code, better behavior, and software that teams can continue to change.
  
  
This role connects long-term technical direction with hands-on software engineering. Done well, it will help teams reduce codebase complexity, modernize with confidence, resolve production problems at their source, and build a stronger foundation for future product development.
  
  
**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset

* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. This is a remote position. To help our teams work together effectively, this role requires you to be located in India.
  
  
We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team, dedicated to developing innovative solutions to make AI services responsible (Responsible AI).
  
  
You will join the
**Responsible AI (RAI) & AI Safety**
engineering team. We are responsible for building, operating, and advancing the centralized AI safety, content moderation, and guardrail platforms powering Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo.
  
  
Our systems run inline and asynchronously across high-throughput production workloads, detecting and mitigating jailbreaks, prompt injection, harmful content, bias, and policy violations while preserving latency and user experience. We partner closely with Product Engineering, Central AI Platform, AI Gateway, Legal, and Trust teams to deliver safety systems that scale globally.
  
  
We have teams in the USA, Australia, New Zealand, and this will be our expansion to India. This team is responsible for building solutions and operating mature platforms to improve the entire company's security and trust & safety posture.
  
  
If you are passionate about improving security, trust & safety, and combating abuse, this role presents a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact!
  
  
**Responsibilities**
At Atlassian, a
**Machine Learning Engineer (MLE)**
is responsible for building, training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models into production systems at scale. The role sits at the intersection of software engineering and data science, requiring production-grade code to turn research prototypes into real-world systems like search ranking, recommendations, and GenAI platforms.
  
  
****What You’ll Do****

* Design & Productionize Safety Models: Architect, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM-based guardrail and moderation models (text, multi-modal, and code) to safeguard user inputs and model outputs across Atlassian products.
* Build Robust Evaluation & Benchmarking: Design offline and online evaluation frameworks, adversarial test suites (red-teaming), and LLM-as-a-judge pipelines to measure precision, recall, false-positive rates, and robustness against model drift.
* Optimize for Real-Time Serving: Work at the intersection of model accuracy and low latency (P50/P99 targets) to deliver cost-effective, high-throughput safety filtering integrated with our central AI Gateway and inference layers.
* Combat Emerging Threats: Research and build defenses against adversarial prompts, jailbreaks, data leakage, hallucinations, and unauthorized tool-calling behaviors in agentic systems.
* Drive Global Compliance & Governance: Support technical readiness for enterprise standards and emerging AI regulations (e.g., EU AI Act, ISO 42001 / AIMS, FedRAMP) through verifiable safety controls, audit logging, and watermarking capabilities.
* Collaborate & Mentor: Partner with engineering managers, staff engineers, data scientists, and product managers to steer technical strategy; provide code/design reviews and mentor junior engineers across the team.

**Compensation**
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Your background**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related quantitative field, with 7+ years of industry experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production.
* Deep hands-on experience with modern NLP and LLM techniques, transformer architectures, prompt engineering, fine-tuning (e.g., PEFT/LoRA), and model alignment.
* Proficiency in Python (and familiarity with Kotlin, Java, or Go) with a track record of writing clean, testable, and performant production-grade code.
* Proven experience constructing rigorous evaluation pipelines, benchmarking datasets, and managing precision/recall trade-offs for high-consequence classification or safety systems.
* Expertise at telling stories with data and familiarity with at least one visualization tool (e.g. Tableau, R-Shiny, Microstrategy, SAP Business Objects, Looker, etc.)
* Experience deploying and scaling ML services in cloud environments (AWS / GCP) using containerized platforms (Kubernetes/Docker) and distributed data processing frameworks (Spark, SQL).
* Strong analytical problem-solving skills, ability to navigate ambiguity, and clear communication skills to articulate ML trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* An agile development mindset focused on constant iteration, solving problems from first principles, and navigating ambiguity.

****It's great, but not required, if you have****

* Experience specifically in Trust & Safety, Content Moderation, or AI Red-Teaming / Adversarial Robustness.
* Hands-on experience optimizing inference engines (e.g., Triton Inference Server, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM) or model quantization techniques for low-latency serving.
* Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, content provenance/watermarking, or regulatory compliance standards (e.g., EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001).
* Experience with large-scale streaming pipelines (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis) or graph-based entity systems.

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
**go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

**Job Title**
IT Applications Developer (PLM)
  
  
**Location**
Bangalore/Chennai
  
  
**About Us**
Ingersoll Rand is a global provider of mission-critical flow creation, life science and industrial solutions. Ingersoll Rand’s Global Engineering & Technology Center (GEC) in Bangalore,
**A GREAT PLACE TO WORK CERTIFIED WORKPLACE**
is driven by an ownership mindset and entrepreneurial spirit, has been a beacon of innovation for over 19 years, embodying our purpose to “Make Life Better” for our employees, customers, shareholders and the planet.
  
  
The Engineering & Technology center has expertly supported a diverse range of industrial products, offering deep expertise in core and digital engineering space. By cultivating a sense of inclusion, belonging and respect, and a collaborative culture, the GEC has fostered the most talented and capable engineers, thereby playing a pivotal role in driving Ingersoll Rand’s purpose and strategic focus areas.
  
  
**Job & Division Summary**
The IT Applications Developer will support the Ingersoll Rand Enterprise PLM program and associated projects. The goal of this initiative is to deploy PTC Windchill globally, leveraging advanced technologies and tools to drive profitable growth across the company.
  
  
This role will contribute to the definition, development, and implementation of best practices for deploying and maintaining various modules of PTC Windchill, along with related engineering applications such as ArborText, and IsoDraw. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with the Enterprise PLM team, champions in each Strategic Business Unit (SBU), and IT delivery teams to deliver sustainable, high-quality solutions
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support the strategy and vision of Enterprise PLM team on solution design, development and configuration.
* Collaborate with PLM architect and other IT teams on the definition, planning, modeling, governance, and implementation of PLM capabilities.
* Help with requirements gathering with business customers for Windchill Implementation projects.
* Collaborate with development team on application development and integrations with upstream (CAD) and downstream (ERPs) systems & applications.
* Ensure ownership and accountability to effectively resolve gaps to completion.
* Lead and support initiatives to minimize support cost and accelerate the delivery of value-added functionality.
* Work proactively to remove technical debt and security vulnerabilities.
* Assess new tools and software, perform POCs, and offer recommendations to optimize the Enterprise PLM ecosystem.
* Provide support in designing & developing scalable, reusable and robust solution frameworks

**Mandatory Requirements**

* Experience:

+ 6+ years of Windchill implementation/customization experience.
+ Strong understanding of Windchill architecture and industrial manufacturing processes.
+ Hands-on experience with Windchill PDMLink/MPMLink customization, configuration, and DB schema.
+ Expertise in workflows, lifecycle management, access control.
+ Experience with CAD data management (Creo, AutoCAD preferred)
+ Experience in using AI to implement and enhance PLM solution in reducing complexity, and accelerating development

* Technical Skills:

+ Proficiency in AngularJS, Java/J2EE, RESTful/SOAP web services, XML, XSD, XSLT.
+ Experience with JSPs, Servlets, MVC frameworks, and OOP concepts.
+ Unix scripting knowledge: Java/J2EE certifications preferred.
+ Familiarity with Windchill Bulk Migrator is a plus.

* Other Requirements:

+ BS in Computer Science or related field.
+ Strong problem-solving, communication, and presentation skills.
+ Ability to map business functionality to out-of-the-box features and identify customization needs.
+ Experience working in large-scale enterprise environments.
+ Creativity and critical thinking applied through technical and business acumen

**Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements**
This position will be a hybrid model based out of Chennai or Bangalore with no anticipated travel
  
  
**What We Offer**

* We are all owners of the company! Stock options (Employee Ownership Program) that align your interests with the company's success.
* Yearly performance-based bonus, rewarding your hard work and dedication.
* Leave Encashments
* Maternity/Paternity Leaves
* Employee Health covered under Medical, Group Term Life & Accident Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* Employee development with LinkedIn Learning
* Employee recognition via Awardco
* Collaborative, multicultural work environment with a team of dedicated professionals, fostering innovation and teamwork.

Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE:IR), driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset, is dedicated to helping make life better for our employees, customers and communities. Customers lean on us for our technology-driven excellence in mission-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www.IRCO.com.

title: Microsoft-CRM technical-Senior
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**AI Business Solutions – Dynamics CRM Technical Senior Specialized:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Lead / Senior Consultant to design, deliver, and optimize enterprise-grade D365 and Power Platform solutions. This role combines deep technical expertise with solution ownership, team leadership, and stakeholder engagement to drive business outcomes across complex CRM environments.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, development, configuration, and implementation of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions aligned with business requirements and best practices.
* Architect and deliver end-to-end solutions across D365 modules including Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, and Field Service.
* Develop and customize CRM components such as entities, forms, views, dashboards, workflows, plugins, and integrations.
* Build custom solutions using C#, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Dynamics 365 SDK, and Web API.
* Design and implement scalable integrations using Azure and Power Platform capabilities.
* Oversee system architecture, performance tuning, testing, troubleshooting, and deployment to ensure optimal functionality and user experience.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to team members, fostering collaboration and high-quality delivery.
* Engage with business and technical stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into clear and actionable discussions.
* Participate in project planning, sprint ceremonies, estimations, and delivery governance using Agile methodologies.
* Stay current with Dynamics 365 and Power Platform advancements, recommending continuous improvements.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM configuration, customization, and solution delivery.
* Proficiency in C#, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS with hands-on experience in plugins and workflows.
* Solid knowledge of Power Platform including Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI.
* Strong understanding of CRM data models, security, and business processes.
* Experience designing scalable, maintainable system architectures.
* Proven problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to quality and performance.
* Effective communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Ability to work independently while thriving in collaborative, Agile teams.
* Developed and customized AI Copilots and agents using Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Dynamics 365 CRM, integrating workflows, Dataverse, and APIs to support intelligent automation and conversational experiences.

**Ideally, you’ll also**
The following skills and experiences are preferred and will be considered an advantage:
  
  

* Power Pages
* Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps (Code Apps)
* PCF (PowerApps Component Framework) Controls
* Integrations using Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, and Azure Service Bus
* Data Migration using SSIS (KingswaySoft) and Azure Data Factory
* Copilot Studio
* Dynamics 365 Project Operations
* Dynamics 365 Field Service
* Dynamics 365 Contact Center

**What We Look For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM development and implementation.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments (Scrum/Kanban).
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Power Platform certifications are preferred.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trusted client and stakeholder relationships.

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer, Portfolio Management Group, Associate
description:
**About This Role**
**About Global Fixed Income Team**
BlackRock’s active fixed income portfolio strategies stretch across a range of investment styles and segments of the fixed income universe. The breadth and depth of our platform puts us in a strong position to potentially deliver attractive returns in various market environments. With a focus on alpha generation and risk management, the team uses a top-down view from lead portfolio managers and bottom-up expertise from our sector specialists.
  
  
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and develop generative AI and machine learning solutions to address fixed income investment and business problems
* Experiment with and implement generative AI techniques such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, and LLM-based workflows
* Build, train, and fine-tune machine learning and deep learning models using appropriate frameworks and methodologies
* Analyze large structured and unstructured datasets to extract insights, engineer features, and support model development
* Apply statistical methods and hypothesis-driven experimentation to evaluate model performance and validate results
* Work closely with portfolio managers, researchers, and business stakeholders to translate investment problems into data science solutions
* Contribute to the deployment and integration of models into production systems, including APIs and scalable pipelines
* Collaborate with data engineers to ensure high-quality data pipelines and efficient data access
* Ensure adherence to responsible AI principles including model interpretability, fairness, and data governance
* Communicate model outputs, insights, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Stay updated with advancements in AI, machine learning, and quantitative methods to continuously enhance solutions

**Education And Qualifications/Skills**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science/Engineering or related field.
* 4+ years of relevant experience.
* Good understanding of the foundations and working principles of machine learning algorithms, linear algebra, probability theory, statistics, and optimization theory.
* Knowledge of at least one of the following domains: generative AI, statistical learning, optimization, NLP, deep learning or time series analysis.
* Should have strong proficiency in the following
* Languages: Python, SQ
* Frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaInde
* Data & Storage: large‑scale distributed data analytics engines, Pandas, Snowflake, FAISS, Pinecone, Chrom
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP, Azure, AWS
* Proficiency in version control systems (e.g., Git/GitHub).
* Strong analytical thinking skills with an ability to creatively solve business problems, innovating new techniques as needed.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Self-driven and results oriented team player with ability to collaborate effectively across geographies/time zones
* Passion for solving interesting and relevant real-world problems in Finance using a data science and AI approaches.
* Prior experience in financial services or large-scale enterprise systems is a plus.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: SAS/Datamart Developer
description:
**Data Management & Analytics Developer**
**Business Data & Analytics**

We are seeking a
**DMA Developer**
to support and evolve enterprise data assets that underpin revenue, sales, analytics, and executive reporting. This role focuses on
**hands‑on development**
,
**data transformation**
, and
**production support**
across SAS (9.x & Viya 4) and Oracle platforms.

**rules‑driven, audit‑sensitive environments**

* Strong experience with SAS 9 and/or SAS Viya development in enterprise data environments.
* Advanced Oracle SQL experience, including views, procedures, packages, and performance optimization.
* Strong understanding of implementing business rules in data logic.
* Experience supporting production data systems with regular release cycles.
* Practical experience using VS Code and GitHub for source control and team development.

* Familiarity with audit‑ or compliance‑driven data environments.

* Knowledge of data lineage, historical tracking, or slowly changing dimensions.
* Exposure to AI‑assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot or similar).

* You become productive quickly in an established SAS and Oracle codebase.
* You independently own well‑defined development and support work, reducing strain on senior engineers.
* You improve data reliability, performance, and confidence without redesigning the platform.
* You collaborate effectively, ask the right questions, and deliver accurate, reliable solutions in a complex environment.

**Team & Environment**

* Part of the Business Data & Analytics (DMA) organization supporting multiple enterprise stakeholders.
* Highly collaborative team of data engineers, analysts, and business partners.

title: Data Product Engineer
description:

*Our solutions and services support everything from renewable energy and electrification to the infrastructure and digital economy shaping our future. Together, we help our customers meet growing demand while driving the industry toward a more sustainable use of the earth’s natural resources.*

We are looking for a
**Data Product Engineer**
to design, build, deploy and operate scalable data products, pipelines and platform capabilities that enable analytics, digital solutions and AI across Metso. You will transform data from multiple enterprise source systems into trusted, reusable and business-ready data assets, contributing throughout the data product lifecycle from design and implementation to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement. * Understanding of automated testing, data quality, monitoring, observability, metadata and data lineage.

description:

Advancing sustainability today, powering a cleaner tomorrow.

PHINIA promotes and cultivates an inclusive culture and diverse perspectives, strives to maintain its reputation for excellence, thrives on the power of collaboration, and fosters the development of our talented employees. We believe in making a positive impact through our business and actions, and we take our collective responsibility seriously.
  
  
**Career Opportunities**
We believe in building a brighter tomorrow for our employees as well as our customers and encourage you to learn about our long history, strong culture, new technologies, and future vision. We offer a strong local presence and interesting global opportunities. Join us on this shared journey toward a brighter tomorrow.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
PHINIA is seeking a Manufacturing Systems Engineer to act as a key bridge between Operational Technology (OT) and Information Technology (IT) across our global manufacturing network. This role is responsible for connecting shop floor automation systems and manufacturing platforms with enterprise applications, enabling reliable, secure, and scalable data flows that support operational excellence, digital manufacturing, and Industry 4.0 initiatives. Working closely with plant teams, automation engineers, IT partners, and manufacturing stakeholders, the Manufacturing Systems Engineer will design and implement solutions that capture, structure, and integrate production data from industrial control systems into central platforms for analytics, reporting, and business processes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Connect to plant‑floor automation systems (Rockwell ControlLogix/CompactLogix, Siemens S7/TIA Portal, and similar) to identify, configure, and extract production data tags for central consumption.
* Configure and maintain OPC‑UA servers and clients (Kepware, Matrikon, native Siemens/Rockwell servers) including certificate management, namespace configuration, subscription tuning, and high‑tag‑count performance optimization.
* Set up and maintain data historians (OSIsoft PI, FactoryTalk Historian, WinCC archives, or similar) — tag configuration, polling rates, compression settings, storage sizing, and downstream access provisioning.
* Build secure integrations between shopfloor systems and MES, ERP (SAP), PLM, and IoT platforms using OPC‑UA, MQTT, SOAP, REST, and AMQP protocols; debug malformed JSON, XML, and SOAP payloads in production.
* Write and optimize SQL queries against production databases for data mining, validation, and troubleshooting; support data quality investigations across the integration chain.
* Work directly with plant ME and maintenance teams to understand their automation landscape, identify available data points, and implement data extraction solutions — often with limited documentation and inconsistent tag naming.
* Navigate IT/OT network segmentation (DMZ, firewalls, data diodes) and coordinate with plant IT/security teams to establish secure data paths from automation networks to enterprise systems.
* Support MES platform implementations and migrations (Rockwell FTPC/MES, Siemens OpCenter, Ignition, or equivalent), including system configuration, operator workflow setup, and production validation.
* Develop and maintain real‑time dashboards and monitoring tools; integrate time‑series data from sensors/PLCs/historians for operational insights (OEE, downtime, scrap, quality trends).
* Train and mentor plant engineers on data extraction techniques, OPC‑UA configuration, and historian usage to build local self‑sufficiency and reduce dependency on central IT.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation including plant integration maps, tag lists, network diagrams, configuration guides, and runbooks.
* Ensure all shopfloor solutions meet PHINIA’s standards for reliability, cybersecurity, ISA/IEC 62443 alignment, Zero Trust, and data integrity.
* Contribute to digital manufacturing initiatives including IIoT enablement, machine connectivity, predictive analytics, and smart‑factory programs.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Automation, Manufacturing Systems, or related technical field
* 6–10 years of experience in manufacturing IT, OT systems, or shopfloor application development/integration
* Hands‑on experience with Rockwell and/or Siemens automation platforms: RSLogix/Studio 5000, FactoryTalk, TIA Portal, WinCC, or their respective historians
* Practical OPC‑UA experience: configuring servers/clients, certificate management, namespace browsing, subscription vs. polling tuning, high‑tag‑count performance
* Experience setting up and configuring data historians (PI, FactoryTalk Historian, WinCC archives, or similar)
* Multi‑protocol integration fluency: OPC‑UA, MQTT, SOAP, REST, AMQP — with comfort reading and debugging JSON, XML, and SOAP payloads
* SQL fluency (joins, window functions, query optimization) for data mining against production databases
* Big data awareness: familiarity with time‑series databases, data lake concepts, and streaming ingestion patterns
* Basic algorithm understanding (sorting, searching, complexity analysis)
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes: traceability, quality checks, OEE, work instructions, operator workflows, machine data capture
* Experience with plant‑floor networking: VLANs, DMZ, edge devices, IoT gateways, barcode/RFID/scanner workflows
* Experience with IT/OT cybersecurity principles, network segmentation, and secured industrial architecture
* Ability to influence without authority and get results in environments with resistant or under‑resourced plant teams
* Patience, diplomacy, and strong communication skills for working with plant‑floor technicians, maintenance teams, and local management
* MES platform certifications (Rockwell, Siemens, Ignition) — preferred
* Microsoft Azure certifications (AZ‑900, AZ‑204) — preferred
* IT/OT security certifications (ISA/IEC 62443 awareness) — preferred

**What We Offer**
We provide compensation and benefits programs intended to attract, motivate, reward, and retain an incredibly talented, globally diverse workforce at all levels within our organization. Our compensation programs are informed by market data and business needs, and we are committed to providing equitable and competitive compensation. We are committed to providing our team with quality and competitive benefit programs, including health and well-being resources, family-centric policies, and an agile workplace program, where not precluded by collective bargaining agreements or national statutory plans. Plans are benchmarked for competitiveness and value.
  
  
We provide formal development opportunities at all levels and stages of employee careers. These opportunities are delivered in a variety of formats to make our portfolio of solutions agile, sustainable, and scalable to support our employees in developing the skills needed to succeed.
  
  
**What We Believe**

* Product Leadership - Innovation that brings value to our customers
* Humility - Seeking out diverse perspectives and working collaboratively
* Inclusivity - Recognizing our differences makes us stronger; we are bold and intentional
* Net-Zero - Committed to energy efficiency, waste reduction and beneficial reuse
* Integrity - Taking responsibility for our decisions and doing what is right
* Accountability - Taking ownership of our actions and driving results

**SAFETY**
You will consistently hear us say Safety First! We are committed to continually improving our strong safety performance supporting the health and wellness of our employees!
  
  
We also believe employee health and safety is everyone’s responsibility. We encourage safety learning and collaboration to help employees understand and follow applicable safety policies, standards, and procedures and identify opportunities to minimize or eliminate risk. Work is expected to be conducted in a manner that stresses the importance of preventing incidents and illnesses, including attending all required safety meetings and trainings. It is expected that all incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions are immediately reported to the direct manager, Human Resources, or Safety Representative.

**VISA SPONSORSHIP**
PHINIA does provide sponsorship for employment visa status based on business need. However, for this role, applicants must be currently authorized to work on a full-time basis, in the country where the position is currently based.

Please note that PHINIA does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or offers from third party recruiters or staffing agencies associated with any published or unpublished employment opportunities. Any unsolicited information sent to PHINIA will be considered as unencumbered and free from any fee or charge whatsoever. Only members of our Human Resources Team have the authority to engage or authorize recruiting services, which must be agreed upon before the unsolicited resume or offer is received.

* Hands-on experience with JMS and enterprise messaging platforms, including Solace and Kafka, for building robust asynchronous communication systems.
* DevOps & Build Tools

* Unix/Linux
* Solid command-line proficiency with Unix-based systems and shell scripting capabilities.

This role will be based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

title: Senior Engineer - AI
description:
**Who Are We?**
Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.
  
  
The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.
  
  
P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.
  
  
**About The Team**
Postman sits at the center of how the world's APIs get built, tested, and consumed. That's an insane dataset. If you've been deep in the agent tooling ecosystem — building with sandboxes, remote execution environments, code generation pipelines — and you've been thinking about what all of this looks like when it's backed by real-world API intelligence at massive scale, this is the role.
  
  
We're building
**Agent Mode**
and the next generation of AI-powered capabilities at Postman. We just released Postman v12, but in the AI world, every day is day zero. Check out the latest demo.
  
  
This doesn’t mean bolting a chat window onto an existing product. It's rethinking what an API platform becomes in an AI-native, API-first world — where agents don't just assist developers, they
*become*
developers. Postman has a unique position to make that real, and we need people who already intuitively understand why.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**You live in this space.**
You're not reading about agents from the sidelines — you're building with them, breaking them, and forming opinions about why certain architectures work and others don't. You can talk about the tradeoffs between different sandboxing approaches, how workspace and execution environments shape agent capabilities, and what the actual bottlenecks are in shipping reliable AI features. Your opinions are evidence-backed because you've done the work, either in production or for exploration.
  
  
**You've used AI to 10x yourself.**
Not theoretically. You have multiple concrete examples — side projects, open source contributions, internal tools, workflow automations — where you used AI tooling to operate at a fundamentally different level of output. If you haven't been experimenting with [almost] every new model, framework, and dev tool that drops, this probably isn't the right fit.
  
  
**You can go from prototype to production.**
We need people who can evaluate a new paper or technique on Monday, have a working prototype by Wednesday, and ship a production-quality version by the end of the week. The space moves too fast for anything less.
  
  
**You know the tradeoffs — and you're still experimenting.**
You can speak to the pros and cons of different orchestration frameworks, context management strategies, tool use patterns, and data pipelines. But you also know that what didn't work last month might work tomorrow with a new model or a different approach.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design and build agent architectures backed by Postman's unique API knowledge graph — collections, environments, schemas, real-world usage patterns across millions of workspaces
* Build and manage the data pipelines and experimentation infrastructure that let us ship AI features fast
* Move between research and production at speed — prototype new approaches, validate them with real users, and iterate relentlessly
* Stay on the bleeding edge of the tooling ecosystem: sandboxes, remote execution, workspace environments, model capabilities, and new paradigms as they emerge
* Collaborate across engineering, research, design, and product to figure out what AI-native API development actually looks like — and then build it

**Why this matters**
Every major AI agent being built today needs to talk to the world through APIs. Postman already has the largest connected API ecosystem on the planet. The opportunity here is to build the intelligence layer that makes AI-native development not just possible but default, in the API-first world. If you've been building agent tooling and wishing you had better data, better distribution, or a bigger surface area to work with, this is it.
  
  
**About You**- 5+ years of engineering experience shipping products at scale
- You've gotten deep enough into AI that you want to work on it full time — and you have the projects, contributions, or experiments to prove it
You sense that there’s a massive opportunity in the AIAPI space waiting to be built.- Product instinct — you care about what ships and whether it works for real users, not just whether the architecture is elegant
